pool-covers.title: How to choose a pool cover
pool-covers.intro: A good cover keeps your pool cleaner, warmer and safer, and cuts the work of looking after it.

sections.p: A cover reduces evaporation and heat loss, keeps out leaves and dirt, and adds safety, especially with children or pets. Over a season it can noticeably reduce running costs.

Automatic covers open and close at the touch of a button and can sit above or below the water. Solar covers capture heat from the sun. Safety covers are built to carry weight. Each suits a different mix of convenience, budget and look.
Your pool's shape and size, how you use it through the year, how important convenience and appearance are, and whether the cover should be hidden when open. These decide which type fits.
Some covers suit existing pools and others are easiest to plan with a new build. We can advise once we know your pool and site.

spas.title: How to choose a spa
spas.intro: A spa is for relaxation, recovery and time together. The right choice depends on space, use and setting.

sections.p: A hot tub is for relaxing and socialising. A swim spa adds a current to swim against and suits training as well as leisure, but needs more space.
Think about how many people will use it at once and whether you prefer to sit, lie down or both.
Outdoor spas need a solid base and sensible access. Indoor spas need floor strength, ventilation and moisture control.
Spas need a suitable electrical supply and a level base. We help you plan both before delivery.
Modern spas make water care straightforward. We explain the routine and can arrange service if you prefer.

saunas-hammam.title: How to choose a sauna or hammam
saunas-hammam.intro: Heat at home is one of the simplest wellness upgrades. The best option depends on how and where you will use it.

sections.p: Traditional saunas give classic dry heat. Infrared cabins warm you directly at lower air temperatures. A hammam is a steam room with high humidity. Barrel saunas are a popular outdoor option.
Outdoor saunas are easier to place and look good in a garden. Indoor ones are available year-round and need good ventilation and moisture protection.
Electric heaters are quick and simple. Wood-fired stoves give a classic experience where regulations allow.
Choose size by how many people will use it, and think about seating height and changing space.
